native_boundary.state: rho_ij=<c_j^dagger c_i>. g0 lesser(m,n)=i U_s(m) rho_s U_s(n)^dagger, bath lesser similarly with ORIGINAL rho_b. No state eigensystem is used to prepare dynamics: eigenvalues are inspected only for fermionic-domain validation. No clipping, logarithm, beta-from-smearing, thermal refill or physical-H density replacement.
native_boundary.propagation: The executable forms Sigma=V g_b V^dagger, including its lesser component. Native cntr::convolution_timestep forms F=-g0*Sigma and Fcc=-Sigma*g0. Native cntr::vie2_start and cntr::vie2_timestep solve (1+F)*G=g0, retaining the full time history. Native g.density_matrix produces equal-time density. The full coupled system Hamiltonian is never propagated in the C++ backend.
native_boundary.branch_scope: A closed REAL-TIME two-branch product-Gaussian IVP, not an equilibrium L-contour function. The initial density is entirely the original g0 lesser source. Zero unused tv storage is justified by the actual convolution and VIE2 equations below, not by an assertion that arbitrary L-contour mixed data can be dropped.
why_unused_branch_inactive: cntr_convolution_impl.hpp:901-975: tv convolution consists of Atv*Bmat plus Aret*Btv. With both tv legs zero it stays zero for any finite Matsubara storage.
cntr_convolution_impl.hpp:1076-1154: the extra lesser imaginary-branch integral is explicitly a product Atv*Bcc_tv-adjoint, hence zero on that invariant subspace.
cntr_vie2_impl.hpp:727-808: startup tv has only Ftv*Gmat and Qtv sources; both are zero, so solved Gtv remains zero.
cntr_vie2_impl.hpp:847-950: the lesser RHS is Qless minus Ftv*Gvt and Fless*Gadv, plus the native real-time retarded*lesser solve; it does not derive initial rho from Matsubara endpoints.

Explicit vie2_start followed by real n>order vie2_timestep bypasses vie2_mat entirely. The reader checks actual altered beta=3.7 and Matsubara sentinel=7.25 against nominal beta=1/storage=0, all real outputs and solved mixed max. NOT EXECUTED.
native_boundary.unsupported_naive_route: Do not call dyson_start/dyson_timestep after simply setting Gtv=0: cntr_dyson_impl.hpp:928-930 initializes Gless(0,n)=-Gtv(n,0)^dagger and would erase the original state. Full vie2() also invokes a Matsubara solve. Neither is used.
native_boundary.source_parallel: Upstream libcntr/test/dyson.cpp:98-119 already uses exactly F=-G0*Sigma, Fcc=-Sigma*G0, vie2_start and vie2_timestep for embedding; A40 changes the Gaussian initial-value source and inactive-branch boundary, not the native integration algorithm.

Hamiltonians and Gaussian states must be finite and Hermitian at the mathematical boundary.
